title: Fix query normalization: space-replace quotes, curly quotes, retry_unquoted fallback
description: Code-review follow-up on df25ce2 (query normalization). (1) Replace quote chars with a space instead of empty string so adjacent tokens don't merge; cover curly U+201C/U+201D and fullwidth U+FF02 quotes. (2) Extract _collapse_ws shared helper (reuse _clean_snippet idiom, \xa0 handling). (3) Replace dead try/except with isinstance type guard. (4) Add retry_unquoted flag (default True): search quoted query first, fall back to unquoted only on genuine 0-results; thread through search_sources/asearch_sources/_apply_grounding(_async) and the 4 public generate methods. (5) Debug log fires only when the query actually changes. Tests for all of it.
close_reason: Query normalization fixes + retry_unquoted fallback implemented, tested (229 pass), committed 923204c

title: Fix Discovery Engine quoted-phrase query collapse (0.3.10)
description: Live-verified defect (2026-08-13): Discovery Engine treats double-quoted phrases as exact contiguous verbatim matches; a quoted long title exists only in document metadata, so keyword AND-semantics collapse the whole query to 0 results. Add pure _normalize_query() to greycloud/grounding.py (strip ", collapse whitespace, preserve apostrophes, never raise -> return original); apply once in search_sources() and asearch_sources() immediately after validation; DEBUG log stripped-quote count. Tests: unit + section-1.5 regression + transport-level (sync requests.post / async httpx.AsyncClient). Release as 0.3.10 (current dev version); bump to 0.3.11 post-release.
close_reason: Released 0.3.10 to PyPI with _normalize_query fix (quoted-phrase collapse); bumped to 0.3.11
